name: Charlotte Russe with Pineapple
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: fine white sugar
ingredients.originalText: half a pound of fine white sugar

ingredients.name: half an ounce of isinglass or patent gelatine
ingredients.originalText: half an ounce of isinglass or patent gelatine
ingredients.quantityText: half an ounce of isinglass or patent gelatine

instructions.text: Peel and cut a pineapple in slices
Put the slices into a stewpan with half a pound of fine white sugar, half an ounce of isinglass, or of patent gelatine (which is better), and half a teacupful of water
Stew it until it is quite tender
Place it upon ice, and stir it well
When it is upon the point of setting, add a pint of cream well whipped
Mix it well and pour it into a mold lined with sponge cake, or prepared in any other way you prefer

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Peel and cut a pineapple in slices
2. Put the slices into a stewpan with half a pound of fine white sugar, half an ounce of isinglass, or of patent gelatine (which is better), and half a teacupful of water
3. Stew it until it is quite tender
4. Rub it through a sieve
5. Place it upon ice, and stir it well
6. When it is upon the point of setting, add a pint of cream well whipped
7. Mix it well and pour it into a mold lined with sponge cake, or prepared in any other way you prefer
